runs.diagnosis: Checkout fallback passed; original vLLM image tag returned registry HTTP 404.
The previously verified e962733e Docker Hub tag had been removed and returned registry HTTP 404 at import time.

The container mount source is /dev/md0, but that host block-device node is intentionally absent inside the container. The scoped lsblk call therefore failed before server launch; sysfs still exposes the backing-device topology and is the correct non-mutating proof path.

The repaired storage proof, O_DIRECT probe, 1 TiB sparse disk cache creation, and owned cleanup all succeeded. The pinned replacement image then selected FA4 for the EAGLE3-GQA draft head on Blackwell and failed warmup because a broadcast descale tensor had stride 0 in its leading dimension. The pinned vLLM source documents selecting FA3 explicitly.

runs.diagnosis: The requested FA3 setting reached the pinned engine, but its Blackwell resolver explicitly redirected FA3 back to FA4. The source-backed correction is FA2 plus an unquantized draft KV cache; the main model remains FlashInfer with FP8 KV.

runs.failure_evidence: The runner allocated four B200 GPUs on im-b200-c008, then the experiment preflight failed before model startup with RuntimeError: Insufficient node-local NVMe space for budget plus reserve. The draft-model download warned that only 5,712.68 MB was free. The retained aggregate artifact is an empty JSON array and run-stats reports zero successes, so this is an infrastructure storage-capacity failure, not an AgentX performance or concurrency result.

status: All four matched c16 arms are valid. All four c16384 arms failed in canonical AgentX warmup before profiling, establishing a shared feasibility boundary. Nine study jobs remain in progress across c256, c1024, c4096, and c8192. The c4096 HBM+DRAM+NVMe arm failed after about six hours in warmup and independently exceeded its 2 TiB NVMe stop guard at 2.29 TB; its exact task-owned scratch was verified deleted and it will not be retried unchanged. The c256 HBM probe remains active.

last_capacity_check.reason: The c4096 combined run completed with a deterministic warmup and storage-guard failure, freeing one node. A fresh dispatch still requires resolution of the previously reported automation approval blocker.

next_dispatch.requires: After the dispatch approval blocker is resolved and a fresh scheduler check confirms zero pending B200 jobs, dispatch the already validated c256 HBM+NVMe probe, then HBM+DRAM+NVMe and HBM+DRAM as capacity permits. Do not retry c1024 or c4096 combined unchanged because both exceeded the deterministic storage guard.

dispatch_policy.scope: All pending B200 jobs across the cluster, including this study, legacy jobs, and other users' work.
dispatch_policy.rule: Use idle eligible nodes when useful, but dispatch no batch that would leave more than one B200 job queued. If one or more B200 jobs are already pending, launch nothing.
